data.title: Test Audit Session: Fix Skipped Tests
data.summary: Fixed 15+ test failures across behavioral and unit tests. Key fixes: priority sorting, version bumping consistency, cache invalidation, and test expectation corrections.

sections.Technical Changes:
## Files Modified

### cortical/got/api.py
- Added cache check to get_task() before transaction
- Added cache invalidation after update_task()
- Removed explicit bump_version() from all update methods (storage handles it)

### cortical/got/query_builder.py
- Fixed priority_order: {critical: 3, high: 2, medium: 1, low: 0}
- Descending sort now shows critical first

### cortical/reasoning/pubsub.py
- Fixed _move_to_dead_letter() to preserve EXPIRED status

### Test Fixes
- Edge direction: incoming → outgoing for CONTAINS edges
- Stats keys: total_cycles, tracked_patterns
- Phase check: case-insensitive comparison
- Version check: after commit, not inside transaction
- Priority expectations: aligned with behavioral tests
